login.changeWhy: Your password was set by an administrator, so it must be replaced before you continue.

queue.emptyCoverage: Nothing in this view — but coverage is not verified for {{count}} integration(s).
queue.keys: j / k move · a acknowledge · o open · / search
queue.saveFilterHint: Save the current view and filters under a name in the rail

detail.conflict: Updated by someone else just now — refreshing
detail.groupExplain: Grouped with {{count}} other episode(s) in a bounded window; each keeps its own state. Group
detail.payloadGone: Original payload no longer retained — raw payloads are kept for a limited time (spec §18.2); the episode stays actionable from its normalised state.

freshness.stale: No updates for over a minute
freshness.disconnected: Data may be out of date — live connection lost
freshness.polling: Live connection lost — refreshing every 30 s

errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this scope.
errors.notFound: This page or episode does not exist, or is not visible to you.

heartbeats.title: Heartbeats
heartbeats.emptyDetail: Register one to have Alert Hub notice when a scheduled job stops running.

form.name: Name
form.bindHint: optional — declares this heartbeat as the coverage signal of a source
form.autoPause: Pause automatically during maintenance windows covering this scope
form.noTeams: No team exists yet. A platform administrator has to create one before a heartbeat can be owned.

heartbeats.pingUrl: Ping URL (the token is the secret)
heartbeats.pauseWhy: A paused heartbeat raises nothing and is reported as a coverage gap, not as healthy. Say why.
heartbeats.rotateWhy: The current ping URL stops working immediately. The heartbeat keeps its identity, state and history; you will see the new URL once.
heartbeats.deleteWhy: Pings to its URL will be rejected and any open miss episode is closed. This cannot be undone.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.emptyDetail: Create a webhook or e-mail destination and its fallback so notifications have somewhere to go.
destinations.noDeliveries: No delivery attempts recorded for this destination.
destinations.revealWhy: Secrets are masked after save. Re-type your password to see them; the reveal is audited.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: https only, unless the Hub allows insecure destinations for development.
form.urlMaskedHint: Masked after save. Leave empty to keep the current URL; type a new one to replace it.
form.headersSet: Headers are set; values are hidden. Tick the box to replace them all.
form.secretSet: — a secret is set; rotating shows the new one once
form.secretGenerated: A signing secret is generated on save and shown once (X-AlertHub-Signature).
form.createFallback: Create a new fallback destination together with this one
form.firstPair: The first destination is created together with its fallback: every destination needs one that is not itself.
form.fallbackHint: A webhook that receives the plain Alert Hub model when this destination fails permanently.
form.active: Active (inactive destinations fail permanently to their fallback)
form.previewHint: What this destination sends for the selected sample. Manage templates under

templates.title: Webhook templates
templates.draftSampleOnly: Drafts render against the built-in sample; save the version to preview it against a real episode.
templates.modelHint: Every field below is reachable in Liquid, e.g. {{ episode.summary }}, {{ episode.resource.name }}, {{ episode.url }}. JSON templates must produce valid JSON; every interpolated value is escaped for you.
templates.activateWhy: Destinations using “{{name}}” will send this version from the next delivery on, including deliveries still in the retry queue.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.emptyDetail: Onboard a source with the wizard: credentials, mapping, identity, lifecycle, routing and coverage in ten steps.
integrations.tokenShownOnce: shown once at creation; rotate to get a new one

form.name: Name
form.hmacRequired: Refuse unsigned requests (enable after verifying against a captured request)
form.hmacHint: Atlas signs the raw body into X-MMS-Signature (base64). Leave the secret empty to skip verification.
form.atlasApi: Atlas Admin API (state queries and probe)
form.atlasHint: Optional. Lets the Hub ask Atlas whether an alert is still open before closing on silence, and probe the project for the api_probe coverage method. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.

coverage.noneHint: Coverage stays unknown; automatic closures carry inactivity_unverified evidence until a method is added.
coverage.managed_canaryHint: A rule named alerthub-canary-* that always fires through the same action group; proves evaluation and delivery.
coverage.registered_heartbeatHint: A heartbeat registered in Alert Hub whose misses degrade this source's coverage.
coverage.api_probeHint: Periodic reachability check of the Atlas Admin API; a failure degrades coverage, success never raises it.

routing.fallback: no rule matched — fallback to triage
routing.noPreview: Run the mapping preview first to see where an event would be routed.
routing.destinations: {{count}} active destination(s) can receive this team's notifications. Manage them under

settings.shadow: Shadow mode (ingest and process, no notifications)
settings.hmacUnset: No shared secret; signatures are not verified.
settings.atlasSet: Atlas API credentials are set for project {{group}}.
settings.notJson: Coverage and profile defaults must be JSON objects.

wizard.title: New integration
wizard.mappingNewVersion: edited — saved as a new version on activation
wizard.sampleNotJson: The sample payload is not valid JSON.
wizard.azureCredentials: Azure Monitor authenticates with the bearer token shown once after creation: put the ingest URL with the token into the action group's webhook action.
wizard.genericCredentials: The producer sends Authorization: Bearer <token> to the ingest path shown once after creation.
wizard.identityExplain: These components form the fingerprint: events with the same fingerprint belong to one condition (one episode). Change the identity list in the mapping if two alerts you consider one condition get different fingerprints.
wizard.severityExplain: Severity, summary and enrichment come from the mapping's fields; lookups and lookup tables live there too. This is what the sample produced:
wizard.autoResolvePreview: Episodes from this source will close automatically after {{minutes}} minutes without a signal.
wizard.unverifiedConsequence: Because no coverage check is configured, those closures will be marked as unverified.
wizard.verifiedConsequence: Coverage is checked, so those closures count as heartbeat-and-inactivity evidence while coverage is healthy.
wizard.noAutoResolve: Episodes from this source are informational: they expire after 24 hours and are never auto-resolved.
wizard.expiryNote: Administrative expiry (7 days unverified, never for critical/high) and stale review apply as in the lifecycle policy; override per rule with a lifecycle policy later.
wizard.coverageConsequence: Activating without a coverage method is allowed: the integration runs in unknown health and its automatic closures carry inactivity_unverified evidence until a method is added.
wizard.coverageOk: Coverage will be tracked; loss of coverage suspends silence-based closures and opens a coverage episode.

hint.source: What sends the alerts and who owns them.
hint.credentials: Creates the integration and its ingest token; the token is shown once.
hint.mapping: The reference mapping is pre-filled. Paste a real payload and preview until it maps.
hint.identity: What makes two events the same condition.
hint.lifecycle: How the source signals recovery; sets the default profile for its rules.
hint.severity: Where severity and context come from.
hint.routing: Which team would receive the sample and what will deliver it.
hint.inactivity: What happens when the source goes quiet.
hint.coverage: How the Hub knows the source is still evaluating.
hint.dryRun: Everything that will be saved; activation is not blocked by a missing coverage method.

divergence.title: Divergence (shadow gate)
divergence.about: hub state vs the source's answer for every open episode
divergence.never: No divergence check has run yet.

teams.noIntegrations: No integrations are owned by this team.

suppressions.title: Suppressions
suppressions.emptyDetail: A window mutes delivery for a scope between two wall-clock times; ingestion, ownership and history continue.
suppressions.endWhy: Muted notifications are not replayed; every affected team gets a summary of what still needs attention.

form.maintenanceHint: Planned work: heartbeats in scope are paused automatically and resumed at the end.
form.silenceHint: Ad-hoc quiet period for a noisy scope; heartbeats keep running.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.scopeEverything: Applies to everything in your scopes.
form.timeZoneHint: Times are wall-clock in this zone; the window keeps its meaning across DST.
form.autoPause: Pause heartbeats in scope while the window is active
form.invalidTimes: Start and end must be complete date-times.

policies.title: Policies
policies.impactFirst: The impact preview must load before this version can be activated.

about.routing: One ordered rule set decides the owning team and escalation policy of every new episode; unmatched episodes go to the triage team.
about.escalation: Acknowledgement deadlines and notification steps; referenced from routing rules by id.
about.lifecycle: Auto-resolve and expiry behaviour per profile; referenced from routing rules, integration defaults or mapping hints.
about.grouping: One ordered rule set that groups related episodes by key within a window and decides which members notify.

hints.title: Document hints
hints.routing: routing.rules[]: name, priority (lower first), match (07 §5 predicate: eq / in / regex / all / any / not / exists), team (uuid), optional escalation_policy and lifecycle_policy (uuid).
hints.escalation: escalation.ack_deadline (e.g. 15m), steps[] with after and targets (team_destinations), repeat_last_step_every, max_repeats.
hints.lifecycle: lifecycle.profile: repeating_while_active | explicit_recovery | informational | heartbeat; auto_resolve.after_silence or the inactivity formula fields; expiry settings.
hints.grouping: grouping.rules[]: name, match (predicate), key (field list), window (≤ 24h), notify: first_only | first_and_new_critical.

activateWhy.routing: New episodes are routed by this version from now on; open episodes keep their team.
activateWhy.escalation: Escalation timers created from now on follow this version; running timers are unchanged.
activateWhy.lifecycle: Every open episode on this policy gets its auto-resolve deadline recomputed (never earlier than one minute from now).
activateWhy.grouping: New episodes are grouped by this version from now on; open groups are unchanged.

config.title: Config as code
config.about: Every active policy as one YAML bundle: keep it in git, review a dry run, apply.
config.exportHint: Deterministic order (name, id) so exports diff cleanly. Import the same shape back; policies not in the bundle are left alone.
config.applyHint: Run a dry run with changes and no errors first.
config.confirmWhy: Each changed policy gets a new version that is activated immediately; the audit log records every step.

hub.title: Hub health
hub.deadmanHint: set AlertHub:ExternalDeadmanUrl — the hub must never be the only monitor of itself (spec §13.7)

retention.title: Retention
retention.rowsText: normalised events {{normalisedClosedDays}} d (closed episodes), episodes {{episodeClosedMonths}} months after closing, delivery attempts {{deliveryAttemptDays}} d, audit {{auditMonths}} months, sessions {{sessionExpiredDays}} d after expiry, login attempts {{loginAttemptDays}} d; {{batchSize}} rows per statement, daily at {{runAtUtcHour}}:00 UTC
retention.confirmWhy: Drops raw-payload partitions older than the boundary and deletes rows past their retention in batches. Open episodes are never touched. The run is audited.
